artifact: Membership records (WP-4.1) and assurance appraisal (WP-4.2): the manifest payload, signed as a COSE_Sign1 of the profile in crates/permguard-objects/src/cose.rs by the coordinator's host.operations key, content type permguard.membership.manifest.v1, its kid that key's <ring>:<thumbprint>; the invitation, the pending membership and the journal entry the store keeps under host/members/; the enrollment and membership requests and answers a peer session carries
authority: 1-architecture/3-architecture-server-host-membership.md, 6-contracts/8-contract-host-api.md (Membership), owner decisions of 2026-10-09 (files, byte shapes, token proof, request digest, manifest delivery, identity reset) and of 2026-10-10 (assurance appraisal); crates/permguard-host/src/membership/record.rs
encoding: deterministic CBOR (RFC 8949 core deterministic), integers in the signed 64-bit range

fields.name: revoke_after_seconds
